The HWPX document automation task succeeded by correctly implementing the training feedback logic and passing the legacy pytest suite.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.71, with all tests passing in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the trajectory was successful, the lower judge reward suggests potential for optimization in code style or handling of edge cases within the HWPX parsing logic. Future iterations should re-check XML namespace handling to ensure robustness against varying HWPX schema versions.
